method: single-double linearized all-order, historical monovalent Yb+ result
limitations: A published SD method also has percent-level deviations for these p excitations; this is not a universal accuracy statement about pCI, AMBiT or EXP-T.
Table I first row is an ionization potential in Ha, not an excitation; exclude it from these comparisons.
Do not treat empirical screening in the separate MBPT(HO) column as parameter-free all-order performance.

Paper discusses near odd-parity 4f-hole mixing; atomx retains 2p1h doubles, so holes are not completely absent. A balanced nonperturbative P-space and higher-order correlations remain untested explanations of any atomx gap.
Do not assume exact all-order orbital space equals the paper MBPT basis; obtain its input before a matched-code validation.
No fitted shift, new physical error correction or tolerance change is authorized by this context.
